component.name: Weather
component.summary: Weather application for the COSMIC Desktop

description.p: Weather for COSMIC is a modern, intuitive, and feature-rich weather forecast application designed natively for the COSMIC Desktop Environment.

ul.li: Live weather telemetry: Real-time temperature, condition states, and daily high/low bounds.
Atmospheric metrics: Detailed readouts for wind speed and direction, humidity, barometric pressure, visibility, UV index, and dew point.
Interactive hourly charts: Beautiful gradient-filled temperature spline curve and precipitation probability bars with easy carousel pagination.
7-day extended forecast: Multi-day predictions with condition icons and temperature trends.
Interactive weather and satellite map: OpenStreetMap Carto tiles with smooth panning, zooming, and click-to-inspect coordinate weather.
Instant place search: Fast location suggestions and geocoding auto-complete.
Saved locations: Star and bookmark favorite cities for instant switching.
Native COSMIC styling: Automatic adaptation to system light/dark themes and accent colors.
